The absolute-trend gate is validated as risk control on this market's history (gate_helps true), but track record shows dir_accuracy 0.316 — directional calls have been worse than coin flips, so conviction should be low everywhere and theses framed as conditional structure reads, not return predictions.
emerging_watch: Watching whether Gold Miners (XGD.TO) can convert its challenger momentum into a durable handoff: I am looking for its breadth to climb from 0.067 above 0.5 AND its score to hold above Oil & Gas Producers for 10 consecutive trading days. If either condition fails to appear by the next monthly rebalance, the watch retires.

theses.subject: Oil & Gas Producers
theses.thesis: This is the prevailing leadership theme and the only top-ranked name with genuine staying-power texture: durability_bar 0.77 (strongest in the eligible universe), breadth 1.0 (every constituent participating), and it is the rotation.leader with score 1.64 versus challenger Gold Miners' 1.19. The absolute-trend gate is eligible=true, so the one validated edge — drawdown/shake-out avoidance — applies here. However, crowding_z 1.27 with crowded=true is a SIZE-DOWN caution, not a reason to be long. Given dir_accuracy 0.316, I am not claiming this predicts returns; I am saying that IF a trend-following allocator must hold something, this is the cleanest structural leader to express, and the crowding flag means do not add to it enthusiastically.
theses.dissent: Crowding_z 1.27 is elevated and crowded=true; attention/flow spikes in thematic ETFs mark tops, and a crowded leader is historically the most fragile to a sharp de-gross on any oil-price or macro surprise. Hurst_tag 'mixed' means the trend is not cleanly persistent — it could chop sideways and bleed slow relative to the benchmark without a clear drawdown event.

falsifier.text: XEG.TO underperforms the S&P/TSX by 8% or more over any rolling 20-trading-day window before the check-by date

theses.subject: Big Banks
theses.thesis: Big Banks (ZEB.TO) are the structurally cleanest non-crowded eligible name: rank 4, score 0.49, eligible=true, hurst_tag 'trend' (the only top-half name with a clean trend tag rather than 'mixed'), durability_bar 0.59, breadth 0.429, and crowding_z 0.25 (not crowded). This is a steady, participation-broadening theme that passes the validated drawdown-control gate without carrying the reflexive crowding risk of the leader. In a tape where the macro narrative is dominated by unscheduled surprises (unscheduled_share 1.0), a lower-beta, trend-tagged financials theme has better shake-out survival characteristics than cyclicals. Not a return call — a de-risked structural lean.
evidence: hurst_tag 'trend' (only top-half eligible name with clean trend)
theses.dissent: Financials are hostage to credit-cycle and rate-path surprises, and with unscheduled_share at 1.0 the macro backdrop is headline-driven; a sharp bank-regulation or credit event would hit ZEB.TO before the energy leader. The detector's dir_accuracy is 0.316, so there is no validated directional edge here — this is a structure preference, not a prediction.

falsifier.text: ZEB.TO breaks below its own 50-day moving average and stays there for 10 consecutive trading days before the check-by date

theses.subject: Utilities & Renewables
theses.thesis: Utilities & Renewables (XUT.TO) are the clearest eligible-failure structural laggard: rank 10, score -0.285, eligible=false (fails the absolute-trend gate, the one validated edge), hurst_tag 'trend' but with negative score and crowding_z -0.88 (neglected, not a contrarian buy). The trend gate failure means this theme does not qualify for the drawdown-control discipline that is the detector's only validated leg. In a rotational field narrowing to 7/16 eligible, non-eligible names are where the allocator should be structurally absent. Not a short — just an underweight/avoid relative to eligible leaders.
theses.dissent: Utilities are a defensive rate-sensitive pocket; if the macro backdrop shifts to a risk-off and bond yields fall sharply, XUT.TO could outperform cyclicals without any trend confirmation. Hurst_tag 'trend' but negative score could mean the trend is just starting to turn — being structurally absent could miss an early defensive bid.

falsifier.text: XUT.TO becomes eligible and its score turns positive for 15 consecutive trading days before the check-by date
